About This Game

Bunker Tidy Up is a meditative game about organizing a space without rushing or pressure. No timers, no panic — just you, the shelves, and thousands of items that need to find their place.


Features:
  • 🕰️ Relaxing gameplay with no timers or stress — play at your own pace
  • 📦 Dozens of supply categories: food, medicine, tools, books
  • 🗄️ More than 100 unique items to sort, each with its own logic for placement
  • 🎨 Cozy, detailed graphics with pleasant sound design
  • 🧩 Simple mechanics accessible to players of all skill levels — perfect for both newcomers and genre fans
